name: Minds 8: watchers alive against the share of watchers
description: The number of watchers alive at the end of the first winter (watcher_alive; window_mean, ticks 190–200) in watch-scroungers' world (theft-winter's winter, no stumbling on caches, every agent burying half its surplus where it stands, no cheaters) against the share of agents that watch (watching.watchers): 0.1, 0.2, …, 0.9, dealt by id. The sweep format takes one metric and no ratio, so it reports the watchers' head count, not the watcher–non-watcher survival gap; the per-capita survival of watchers and non-watchers (watcher_alive and other_alive against each group's starting size) comes from the survey. Seeds 1–20.
